music.why: Creation sung as good: the world the prophets hoped would be renewed, not escaped.
Messiaen's quartet, written in a prisoner-of-war camp, on Revelation 10's angel who announces the end of time.
'Sleepers, wake': Bach's cantata on the wise and foolish virgins.
Brahms sets 1 Corinthians 15 and 'blessed are the dead'.
The Dies irae: the Last Judgement in music.
The great multitude of Revelation 7, sung.
Messiah ends with Revelation 5, 'Worthy is the Lamb'.
